programme.title: Omonia Nicosia vs Benfica - UEFA Europa League 2026/2027 - MD 3
programme.desc: Omonia Nicosia and Benfica faced in the 1981-82 European Cup first round, with Benfica winning both legs. This is the first major European meeting between a Cypriot team and Portuguese team since APOEL Nicosia won 2-1 against FC Porto in the UEFA Champions League in November 2011 – that is the only win for a Cypriot team in 10 meetings.

programme.title: Dinamo Zagreb vs NEC - UEFA Europa League 2026/2027 - MD 3
programme.desc: Dinamo Zagreb have won one of their last eight major European games against Dutch teams, though it was in their most recent encounter in December 2020 against Feyenoord in the UEFA Europa League, winning 2-0. NEC and Dinamo Zagreb have met once before, with the Croatians winning 3-2 at home in the UEFA Cup in October 2008.

programme.title: Lillestrøm vs Real Sociedad - UEFA Europa League 2026/2027 - MD 3
programme.desc: Lillestrøm have only faced a Spanish team in one previous European season, losing 5-3 on aggregate to eventual runners-up Alavés in the second round of the 2000-01 UEFA Cup. Real Sociedad’s only previous encounter with a Norwegian team saw them win both group stage games against Rosenborg in the 2017-18 UEFA Europa League.
